about_short_description.short_description: Sarwa is a financial platform and app that lets you easily trade stocks and ETFs, save and invest your money passively all in one place.

product.name: Sarwa Trade
product.description: A platform to buy and sell thousands of U.S. stocks and ETFs with no withdrawal fees or transfer costs for AED accounts and no minimum trade amount.

product.name: Sarwa Invest
product.description: An automated investing service offering expert-built portfolios with smart rebalancing and dividend reinvestment for passive investors.

product.name: Sarwa Save
product.description: A high-yield cash savings account offering estimated returns around 4.4% with no withdrawal fees or lock-ups, including a Halal savings option.

product.name: Sarwa Crypto Trading
product.description: A regulated platform to buy and sell top cryptocurrencies with zero commission and competitive spreads, supporting fractional purchases and various order types.

product.name: Retirement Calculator
product.description: A free online tool that estimates the amount of savings needed for retirement based on user inputs and assumptions about investment returns and life expectancy.
